data.name: Fayyad
data.gender_notes: Fayyad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'f-y-d', which means 'to be present, to help, to aid, or to serve'. In Islamic tradition, Fayyad is a name for one who is always present and helpful, serving Allah and His creation. The name Fayyad carries the meaning “A servant, helper, or supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fayyad usually hope their child will grow to embody a servant, helper, or supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a servant of Allah, one who is always present and supportive.
data.etymology: Fayyad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A servant, helper, or supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fayyad total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_urdu.name: فیاض
